definitions.explanation: The cancellation of a scheduled flight, ship, or other transportation service, typically due to weather or other conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{欠航|けっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{台風|たいふう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{欠航|けっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be cancelled due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{欠航|けっこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The flight was cancelled due to the blizzard.

notes:
{欠航|けっこう} means the cancellation of a scheduled flight, ferry, or other transportation service. Usually caused by weather (typhoons, snow, fog) or mechanical issues.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {欠航|けっこう}になる: to be cancelled (intransitive)
- {欠航|けっこう}する: to cancel service
- {欠航|けっこう}が{相次|あいつ}ぐ: cancellations pile up one after another

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠航|けっこう}{便|びん}: cancelled flight
- {欠航|けっこう}{情報|じょうほう}: cancellation information
- {台風|たいふう}で{欠航|けっこう}: cancelled due to typhoon

HOMOPHONE WARNING:
Do not confuse with:
- {決行|けっこう}: to carry out, proceed (despite obstacles)
- {結構|けっこう}: quite; fine; no thank you

RELATED:
- {運休|うんきゅう}: service suspension (mainly for trains/buses)
- {遅延|ちえん}: delay
